name: Horseshoe Bay Resort
positioning: Lakeside golf resort on the shores of Lake LBJ in the Texas Hill Country, with a marina, a waterfront spa and a beach
best_for: Golfers who want Robert Trent Jones, Sr. courses
Families and groups who want villas or private homes
Travelers who want lake time: boating, paddleboarding and sunset cruises

facts.text: Horseshoe Bay Resort sits on the shores of Lake LBJ in the Texas Hill Country.
The resort covers 7,000 acres, combining a country club and a lakeside yacht venue.
The resort has a marina, the Bayside Spa and a Waterfront Beach.
The resort has three Robert Trent Jones, Sr. golf courses.
The Tower has hotel rooms and suites with views of the property and the Texas Hill Country.
The Palm Presidential is the largest hotel suite, with a kitchenette, dining table, stone fireplace and separate living space.
The Magnolia Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony with views of the hotel pool or Lake LBJ.
The one-bedroom Palm Villas are Tuscan inspired, with a kitchenette and a private balcony or patio with resort views.
Rooms are designed in neutral grays and cream with a contemporary feel, and marble bathrooms have walk-in showers.
The resort has multiple tennis and pickleball courts, a full-service spa, several pools and a kids club.
The resort has an airport and jet center with hangar spaces and aircraft parking.
Dining across the resort includes steak, Texas barbecue, Gulf Coast seafood and spa-inspired dishes.

highlights.text: The resort offers kayak, paddleboard and boat rentals, and has a yacht club and marina on Lake LBJ.
Staff can organize sunset cruises on the lake or wine tours in the area.
The Executive Suite has views of Lake LBJ from a furnished private balcony.
The resort's golf courses were designed by World Golf Hall of Fame members Robert Trent Jones, Sr., and Jack Nicklaus.
Guests of the Private Homes and Signature Residences can use the Yacht Club's outdoor amenities, including a lagoon-style pool and a white sandy lakeside beach.

considerations.text: Some restaurants have specific dress codes, so pack the proper attire.
The Yacht Club's lagoon-style pool and lakeside beach are for Private Homes and Signature Residences guests; the listed townhomes and condos do not include that access.
WhataHotel notes the resort is a drive from downtown Austin.
